notes.title: [FIXED] Save Game Issue - Fixed
notes.content:
Dear Clickers,

Thanks for your feedback, bug reports and support in the last 24 hours. We worked hard to get the save game error fixed and also included some improvemetns of the game which where suggested in the forum

Here a small overview:
Fixed:

[Fixed] Save game resetts when no internet connection is available 
[Fixed] Double Damage from crystal shop not working properly

- Included a warning message before ascention is activiated

Further details are available in the community forum.

If any further issues arise we are looking forward to your feedback and reports so we can fix anything as soon as possible !

Well then,
Have fun clicking !

notes.title: Clicker Guild - Release
notes.content:
Dear clicker fans, 

today is the day of our release and we are very happy to see it launch on Steam. Are you ready for the loot system and a challenging clicker? We are and hope that you are as well, so let the clicking begin.

Recruit guild members, unlock skills by leveling them up and show the monsters who's the strongest. You can also strengthen your recruits by collecting items or increase the total damage by favors.
There is an neverending road with monsters ahead, so be sure to keep up.

So good luck finding the best loot possible and of course - have fun!
